Opinions on Establishing a Joint Conference System for the Reform of Family Trial Methods and Working Mechanisms

Fa Fa [2017] No. 18

To strengthen the organizational leadership and overall coordination of the reform of family trial methods and working mechanisms, enhance collaboration and cooperation among departments, and promptly study and resolve major issues encountered in the work, a Joint Conference for the Reform of Family Trial Methods and Working Mechanisms (hereinafter referred to as the "Joint Conference") system is hereby established.

I. Main Functions

Under the leadership of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, to coordinate and promote the reform of family trial methods and working mechanisms. To study and formulate policies and measures for the resolution of family dispute cases and annual work plans, explore reforms in family trial procedures, and submit legislative proposals to the National People's Congress regarding special family procedures; to promote departmental communication and collaboration, clarify responsibilities and task divisions, strengthen policy linkage and work alignment, and advance the improvement of diversified dispute resolution mechanisms; to promote the combination of professionalization and the mass line in family trial work; to supervise and inspect the implementation of marriage and family dispute resolution work, and promptly report on work progress; to complete other tasks assigned by the Central Committee.

II. Member Units

The Joint Conference is composed of 15 departments and units, including the Supreme People's Court, the Office of the Central Committee for Comprehensive Management of Social Security, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Ministry of Justice, the National Health and Family Planning Commission, the General Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television, the Office of the National Working Committee for Children and Women under the State Council, the All-China Federation of Trade Unions, the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, the All-China Women's Federation, the China Committee for the Care of the Next Generation, and the National Working Committee on Aging, with the Supreme People's Court as the lead unit.

The Executive Vice President of the Supreme People's Court shall serve as the convener of the Joint Conference, and the relevant responsible persons of each member unit shall serve as members of the Joint Conference. If a member of the Joint Conference needs to be adjusted due to job changes, the unit to which they belong shall propose it, and the Joint Conference shall determine. If necessary, the Joint Conference may invite other relevant departments to participate.

The Office of the Joint Conference is established at the Supreme People's Court, responsible for the daily work of the Joint Conference. The director of the Office shall be concurrently held by a leader of the Supreme People's Court. Liaison officers are appointed, served by the relevant department heads of each member unit; information officers are appointed, served by the relevant division-level heads of each member unit.

III. Working Rules

The Joint Conference shall, in principle, hold a plenary meeting once a year, presided over by the convener or a person designated by the convener. Temporary meetings may be held as needed. Before the plenary meeting, a meeting of liaison officers shall be held to study and discuss the agenda of the Joint Conference and matters to be submitted for decision. The Joint Conference shall specify the matters decided at the meeting in the form of meeting minutes. The meeting minutes, after being agreed upon by the participating units, shall be printed and distributed to relevant parties, and at the same time, copies shall be submitted to the State Council and the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission. Major issues shall be discussed by the Joint Conference and then decided by the lead unit reporting to the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission.

IV. Work Requirements

Each member unit shall, in accordance with its division of responsibilities, proactively study issues related to the reform of family trial methods and working mechanisms and the resolution of marriage and family disputes, and promptly submit to the lead unit agenda items requiring discussion by the Joint Conference; actively participate in the Joint Conference, earnestly implement the work tasks and decisions determined by the Joint Conference, and promptly handle issues requiring cross-departmental coordination. Each member unit shall share information, cooperate with and support each other, form a joint force, give full play to the role of the Joint Conference, and jointly do a good job in the reform of family trial methods and working mechanisms.

Attachment: Division of Responsibilities and Tasks of the Member Units of the Joint Conference for the Reform of Family Trial Methods and Working Mechanisms

July 18, 2017

Attachment

Division of Responsibilities and Tasks of the Member Units of the Joint Conference for the Reform of Family Trial Methods and Working Mechanisms

To strengthen the organizational leadership and overall coordination of the resolution of marriage and family disputes, promote the deepening development of the reform of family trial methods and working mechanisms, safeguard the harmony and stability of marriage and families in accordance with the law, protect the legitimate rights and interests of minors, women, and the elderly, cultivate and practice socialist core values, and promote social construction, the division of responsibilities and tasks of each member unit is determined as follows:

I. Office of the Central Committee for Comprehensive Management of Social Security

To give full play to the role of comprehensive management centers at all levels, promote the improvement of diversified dispute resolution mechanisms, and ensure the implementation of responsibilities for investigating and mediating marriage and family disputes. To strictly implement the comprehensive management leadership responsibility system, incorporate the work of resolving marriage and family disputes into the assessment of comprehensive management work (peace building), and carry out supervision and inspection, commendation and awards, responsibility supervision, and accountability in accordance with relevant central regulations. To coordinate relevant member units of the Central Committee for Comprehensive Management of Social Security to actively participate in and earnestly do a good job in protecting the rights of women, children and the elderly, and implement comprehensive management leadership responsibility supervision and accountability for localities, units and departments where major criminal cases with adverse effects occur.

II. Supreme People's Court

To guide local people's courts at all levels to promptly accept and hear marriage and family cases in accordance with the law. To rely on the reform of the diversified dispute resolution mechanism to establish a multi-mediation mechanism for family disputes with broad social participation; to rely on the reform of the trial-centered litigation system to explore reforms in family trial procedures; to rely on the reform of the judicial personnel classification management system to explore the professionalization of family trial institutions and teams. The trial of cases shall shift from focusing on property division and property rights protection to comprehensively paying attention to the parties' identity rights, property interests, personality interests, security interests, and emotional interests. To pay attention to distinguishing between marriage crises and marriage breakdowns, actively resolve marriage crises, and correctly handle the relationship between protecting the freedom of marriage and maintaining family stability. To implement the divorce certificate system and explore the establishment of information sharing mechanisms with civil affairs departments.

To promptly summarize experiences and explore the professionalization of family trials from multiple aspects, such as trial organization, team building, standards of proof, prevention of domestic violence, declaration of family property, and litigation procedures. To strengthen training on mediation skills, psychology, and sociological knowledge for family judges and judicial assistants. To guide courts at all levels to strengthen hardware facility configuration and improve the level of equipment for business operations. To actively strive for the leadership of the Party committee and strong support from all sectors of society, and promote the formation of a favorable working pattern of "Party committee leadership, government responsibility, court leadership, and social participation."

III. Supreme People's Procuratorate

To guide the procuratorial organs nationwide to fully perform their procuratorial functions, strengthen legal supervision over the work of public security organs, courts, and other relevant departments in protecting the rights of women, children, and the elderly. To punish various crimes against family members in accordance with the law and pursue the legal responsibility of the perpetrators. When a guardian is prosecuted for a guardianship abuse crime, the procuratorial organ shall, in writing, inform the ward and their close relatives or in writing suggest that the civil affairs department apply to the court for revoking the guardian's qualification in accordance with the law.

IV. Ministry of Education

To guide local education departments to ensure that school-age children and adolescents have equal access to compulsory education in accordance with the law, strengthen educational care for students with special family difficulties, and help children from single-parent families, left-behind children, and children in difficult circumstances maintain emotional connection and family communication with their parents. To organize and carry out work to prevent dropout and ensure attendance, implement policies for free compulsory education and educational financial aid, and ensure that school-age children and adolescents do not drop out of school due to family difficulties. To supervise and urge primary and secondary schools, kindergartens, and their staff to establish a mandatory reporting awareness, and when discovering that minors in primary and secondary schools and kindergartens have suffered from family guardianship abuse, they shall make a mandatory report.

To promote local education departments to actively carry out family education work, clarify the main responsibility of parents in family education, and strengthen the guidance of school family education work. To cooperate with relevant organizations such as the Women's Federation and the China Committee for the Care of the Next Generation to jointly run parent schools; relying on public service venues such as youth palaces, rural children's palaces, and children's activity centers to provide family education guidance services for minors of different age groups and their families in urban and rural areas; to coordinate various social resource units, guide local education departments to actively guide diverse social entities to participate in family education guidance services.

V. Ministry of Public Security

To guide public security organs nationwide to crack down on crimes against the rights of women, children, and the elderly in accordance with the law, implement the Anti-Domestic Violence Law, receive personal safety protection orders served by the people's courts, and assist the people's courts in the enforcement of personal safety protection orders. To guide public security organs nationwide, when receiving reports of domestic violence or reports of repeated domestic violence violating personal safety protection orders, to promptly dispatch police and handle them in accordance with the provisions of the Anti-Domestic Violence Law, the Public Security Administration Punishments Law, and other laws and regulations.

VI. Ministry of Civil Affairs

To formulate marriage management policies and guide local civil affairs departments in implementation, and promote marriage and family counseling work. To increase the informationization construction of marriage registration and promote the construction of a marriage registration information database. To guide marriage registration agencies with conditions to set up marriage and family counseling rooms to provide legal consultation, emotional counseling, psychological guidance, dispute resolution, pre-marital education, and other services to parties in need.

To take the lead in promoting the care and protection of left-behind children in rural areas; to take the lead in formulating development plans, work policies, and measures for the protection of minors, promote the establishment of a social protection system for minors, and take the lead in formulating policies and safeguard measures for the protection of the rights and interests of children in difficult circumstances; to guide rescue management agencies, welfare institutions, and minor protection institutions at all levels to play a safety net role, do a good job in rescuing and protecting minors in difficult circumstances in accordance with the law, and provide care services for minors through government purchase of services and other means; to establish anti-domestic violence shelters in qualified localities to effectively protect the rights and interests of victims of domestic violence.

VII. Ministry of Justice

To guide the vast number of people's mediation organizations to give full play to their functional advantages and promptly and effectively resolve marriage and family disputes. To strengthen the team building of people's mediation organizations for marriage and family disputes, promote the establishment of people's mediation committees for marriage and family disputes at the county (city, district) level according to local conditions, select and employ professionals as people's mediators, set up public welfare positions for full-time mediators, and strengthen professional training and commendation awards for people's mediators handling marriage and family disputes. To supervise and ensure the funding for people's mediation of marriage and family disputes, include people's mediation work for marriage and family disputes in the government purchase service guidance directory, and improve guarantee standards and levels.

To guide judicial administrative organs at all levels to conduct in-depth publicity of laws, regulations, and policies on marriage, family, and minor protection through various forms, such as explaining the law through cases, community legal education, and targeted legal education for key groups. To actively guide legal service personnel to provide professional services such as legal aid and legal services for women, children, and the elderly whose rights and interests have been violated.

VIII. National Health and Family Planning Commission

To guide medical institutions to promptly accept and treat victims of domestic violence, make diagnosis and treatment records, and assist in injury identification, physical and mental health status assessment, and other work. To guide medical institutions and their staff to establish a mandatory reporting awareness for those who have suffered or are suspected of suffering from domestic violence who are persons without or with limited capacity for civil conduct, and carry out mandatory reporting work.

IX. General Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television

To guide press, publication, radio, film, and television departments at all levels to strengthen the publicity of family virtues, anti-domestic violence, and policies, laws, and regulations on the protection of the rights and interests of women, children, and the elderly, and guide family members to consciously fulfill their family responsibilities. To organize radio and television media to extensively publicize and report on civilized families, advanced models for the protection of the rights and interests of women, children, and the elderly, and create a good social atmosphere of respecting the elderly and loving the young, gender equality, and family harmony.

X. Office of the National Working Committee for Children and Women under the State Council

In promoting the implementation of the "Program for the Development of Chinese Women (2011-2020)" and the "Program for the Development of Chinese Children (2011-2020)", to coordinate relevant departments to strengthen functions, formulate measures, and do a good job in the protection of women's and children's rights, the resolution of marriage and family disputes, and the publicity of civilized family traditions. To play a coordinating role, promote relevant departments to solve prominent issues related to the legitimate rights and interests of women and children in the field of marriage and family, and publicize and promote the experience of regions and departments with significant results. To take the objectives, tasks, and division of responsibilities of relevant departments determined by the Joint Conference as key concerns in the implementation of the programs over the next five years, and consider and incorporate them when formulating the new cycle of programs for the development of women and children.

XI. All-China Federation of Trade Unions

To safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of workers, guide and educate workers to improve their ideological and moral standards, pay attention to the cultivation of family virtues, assist relevant mediation organizations in jointly mediating workers' family disputes, and promote the construction of family civilization. To strengthen the assistance and humanistic care for workers, especially migrant workers, by carrying out brand activities such as sending warmth, autumn study assistance, safe return home for migrant workers, and care for female workers, help them solve life difficulties, strengthen family care, and organize and lead workers to carry out peaceful family creation activities. To do a good job in safeguarding the legitimate rights and special interests of female workers and promote the resolution of prominent issues violating the rights and interests of female workers.

XII. Central Committee of the Communist Youth League

To implement the target requirements in the "Mid- to Long-Term Youth Development Plan (2016-2025)" in the field of "youth love and marriage", work with relevant functional departments, mass organizations, and social organizations to strengthen education on youth love and marriage concepts and family values, promote a healthy and positive new trend in love and marriage; extensively carry out youth social activities, develop public welfare projects to improve youth love and marriage services, provide youth love and marriage psychological counseling and behavioral guidance, and carry out youth sexual health education and education on eugenics and superior upbringing; focus on providing marriage services for older unmarried youth and other groups.

To earnestly perform the duties of the lead unit of the special group for the prevention of juvenile delinquency of the comprehensive management committees at all levels and the office of the minor protection committee, deepen the creation of "youth rights protection posts", carry out pilot projects for "youth zero crime zero victim communities (villages)", promote the resolution of prominent issues infringing on the rights and interests of youth, conduct ideological and moral education and legal popularization for youth, and promote the improvement of relevant laws, regulations, and policy systems. To build "Youth Voice", "Youth Rights Protection Online", and the 12355 Youth Service Platform, connect professional forces in law, psychology, and other fields as well as youth affairs social work service agencies, and provide professional services such as assistance, legal consultation, mental health, and self-protection education for youth.

XIII. All-China Women's Federation

To guide women's federations at all levels to actively carry out legal publicity and education, promote the prevention and cessation of domestic violence, and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of women, children, and other family members. To organically combine family dispute mediation and judicial participation with legal publicity, good family tradition education, and family virtue construction, guide family members to establish correct marriage and family concepts, inherit good family traditions and family discipline, and promote traditional family virtues. To organize and carry out activities such as searching for "Most Beautiful Families", "Building a Rule-of-Law China, Women in Action", and "China Women's Legal Aid Action", establish well-functioning petition reception rooms at all levels of women's federations, keep the 12338 women's rights protection service hotline open, expand online and other complaint acceptance channels, and assist in mediating marriage and family disputes and other cases involving the legitimate rights and interests of women and children. To do a good job in conflict investigation, psychological counseling, dispute mediation, petition agency, legal assistance, and hardship assistance.

To actively participate in the prevention and resolution of marriage and family disputes. To guide women's federations at all levels to consolidate the foundation for grassroots marriage and family dispute mediation, jointly establish professional people's mediation committees for marriage and family disputes with judicial administrative departments and other organs, strengthen the training of professional talents for marriage and family dispute mediation, and actively participate in pre-litigation mediation, in-litigation conflict resolution, and post-judgment return visits and assistance for family cases in courts. To recommend outstanding women's federation cadres to serve as people's jurors in courts, promoting fairness and democracy in the family trial process.

XIV. China Committee for the Care of the Next Generation

To organize and mobilize retired veteran cadres, soldiers, experts, teachers, and model workers to give full play to their political advantages, experience advantages, and prestige, carry out various forms of marriage and family dispute mediation and care services for minors, and collaborate on family dispute resolution and minor protection work.

XV. National Working Committee on Aging

To study and propose suggestions and countermeasures for improving policies and laws on the protection of the rights and interests of the elderly, and propose legislative suggestions; to organize, coordinate, and supervise the implementation of work by member units of the Committee on Aging and local aging work institutions, guide and promote relevant departments to do a good job in legal rights protection for the elderly; to accelerate the introduction of family support policies for the elderly, strengthen the protection of the rights and interests of left-behind elderly in rural areas, carry out research on guardianship-related work for the elderly, and guide the signing of agreements for the support or maintenance of the elderly in rural areas.
